notes: README.md:61 recommends Docker Compose and defers all other docs to docs.pixelfed.org / developers.pixelfed.org (external, not read). The only in-repo setup guide is DOCKER_COMPOSE_SETUP.md, written for a production-style deploy behind a reverse proxy; for local use APP_URL etc. can point at http://localhost:8080. All artisan steps are run via 'docker compose exec pixelfed php artisan ...'. The image COPYs the source (no code bind mount, opcache timestamps off, route/view/config caching on), so code edits need a rebuild - poor fit for active development. Alternatives present but undocumented: a .ddev/ config (MariaDB 11.8 + Redis, preset APP_KEY, PHP 8.5) and a bare-metal path implied by CI + .env.example: composer install, cp .env.example .env, php artisan key:generate, create MySQL DB, php artisan migrate, passport:keys, instance:actor, storage:link, php artisan serve (needs PHP ext-redis, ext-ffi and libvips since IMAGE_DRIVER=vips). CI only runs tests (cp .env.testing .env, key:generate, SQLite + Redis), never a running instance. Compiled JS/CSS are committed in public/ (CONTRIBUTING says maintainers build them), so no npm step is needed; .node-version (v14.20.1) is stale relative to esbuild 0.25 / webpack 5 deps. PHP: composer allows ^8.4, README recommends 8.5, CI tests 8.5 only. DB: README says MySQL 8+ / MariaDB 11+ (Postgres best-effort); compose uses mysql:9.
